Subject: Shipment SH-0182 delayed
From: dispatch@orbit.example

Our shipment SH-0182 of CAM-360 (surround-view camera kit) for Wacky Wheels Princeton (P_IN) was due 2027-03-15 and will now arrive 2027-03-18. Reason: port congestion.

incidents.span: CAM-360 (surround-view camera kit) port congestion SH-0182  2027-03-15 2027-03-18

summary: E-12 is Supplier delay. 3 production orders move (3 rescheduled, 0 transferred). 14 dealer notice(s) and 10 loaner assignment(s).
reasoning: Walked SH-0182 → CAM-360 → SUMMIT, VOYAGER (bill of materials) → production orders at P_IN from 2027-03-15 up to 2027-03-18. 3 orders need the delayed part. Rule 1 and rule 3. Placed 3 at the same plant and transferred 0. Rule 4: 14 dealer notice(s), one each, listing only affected customer orders. Rule 5: 10 loaner(s) for Platinum and Gold in priority order; 0 entitled order(s) left without a car because the pool ran out. Standard customers are on the dealer notice only. Guardrail: only orders, vehicles, dealers, and customers reached by the walk are touched. Shared slots and loaner pools are one board for the whole event, so a compound message cannot double-book them.

handoffs.did: Split the message into 1 incident(s) and dispatched specialists.
